Faq.pageSubtitle: Everything you need to know about AllCombiner. Can't find an answer? {contactLink}.
Faq.a1: Our pipeline uses a centralized prompt that explicitly instructs the model to preserve facial structure, eyes, eyebrows, nose, mouth, jawline, ears, hair, skin tone, age and distinctive features of each reference. We do not average or morph the faces.
Faq.a2: We accept JPG, PNG and WEBP. Files must be under 10 MB and no larger than 4096px on either side. Validation is performed both client-side and server-side.
Faq.q3: How long does a fusion take?
Faq.a3: Most generations complete in 15–45 seconds depending on the model selected. Nano Banana 2 Lite is the fastest, Nano Banana Pro is the highest fidelity.
Faq.q4: Can I change the AI model?
Faq.a4: End users see the model that the administrator has set as active in the admin panel. Administrators can switch between Nano Banana 2 Lite, Nano Banana 2 and Nano Banana Pro at any time — the change takes effect immediately for the next generation.
Faq.a5: We store the minimum required for audit and reproducibility: input thumbnails and output images are kept for 30 days, then automatically deleted. You can request deletion at any time via the contact page.
Faq.a6: Yes. We are GDPR compliant. See our privacy policy for details on data controllers, retention and your rights.
Faq.q7: Can I use the photos commercially?
Faq.a7: Yes, on paid plans. Free plan outputs are licensed for personal use only. See your plan's terms for details.
Faq.q8: What if the result doesn't look like the people in the photos?
Faq.a8: Identity fidelity depends on the quality of the input photos. Use well-lit, front-facing photos with the face clearly visible. If you are on a paid plan and the result is unsatisfactory, contact us — we may credit your account.

Privacy.pageSubtitle: How we collect, use and protect your data.
Privacy.collectBody: We collect your email address and password (hashed) when you create an account. When you generate a fusion, we store the input thumbnails and output image for 30 days for audit and reproducibility.
Privacy.useBody: Your data is used solely to provide the AllCombiner service, prevent abuse, and comply with legal obligations. We never sell your data.
Privacy.rightsBody: Under GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict processing, and port your data. To exercise these rights, contact us via the contact page.
Privacy.retentionBody: Account data is retained for as long as your account is active. Generated content is retained for 30 days then automatically deleted.
Privacy.thirdPartyBody: We use OpenRouter as our AI inference provider. OpenRouter processes your input images and prompt solely to return the fused image. See OpenRouter's privacy policy for details.
